aim: Determine whether publicly observable Binance BTCUSDT spot trading turnover and aggressive taker-side imbalance increased during public Terra/Celsius/3AC/FTX shock windows; NOT claim confirmed forced selling.

metricSchema.volume: daily BTC traded quantity on Binance BTCUSDT spot
metricSchema.quoteVolume: daily USDT not USD traded value
metricSchema.takerBuyBase: daily BTC volume initiated by aggressive BUY market orders
metricSchema.takerSellBase: volume-takerBuyBase, BTC volume initiated by aggressive SELL market orders

archive: Verify original Binance SHA256 CHECKSUM exact ZIP, ZIP CRC/unique daily klines, 12 cols and stable YYYY-MM month; R2 store original ZIP raw with readback SHA plus report and manifest readback, never invent values on 429/404.
metrics: Per 14-day window daily mean/median base BTC turnover and quote USDT traded, daily sum takerBuy/takerSell, weighted net taker imbalance, ratio shock/pre for base and USDT turnover, exact daily table, max turnover day, magnitude if valid.
caution: A matched buyer exists for every sale: cannot call executed volume 'BTC net sales'. Taker-side aggression is direction of marketable orders, not forced sales, institutional wallet flow, market-wide volume or one investor's motive. Binance BTCUSDT is one venue, not market aggregate. Monthly archive was published AFTER event, so usable for retrospective measurements, not a 2022 live signal without contemporaneous exchange API.
hypothesis: Volume/imbalance spike may quantify panic at headline but not forecast secret exchange insolvency or pre-headline liquidation. Do not claim causal news price effect.
